# Plugin Galaxy · `dsh-plugin-galaxy` [![ci](https://github.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy)](https://github.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy/releases/latest) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![host](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.1.5%20%7C%200.2.1-informational)](docs/host-compatibility.md) [![telemetry](https://img.shields.io/badge/telemetry-none-success)](#权限与安全) > **于万千插件中甄选价值，DeepSeek Harness 扩展更轻盈。** > A visual plugin galaxy inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and install community plugins without leaving the app. 装在 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）设置对话框**里的插件市场：逛、搜、看排名、一键安装， 更新/启停/卸载/备份恢复/诊断也在同一个面板里完成。它**不占侧栏座位**， 不往会话里塞命令，也不在后台偷偷跑活儿 —— 只有你打开设置时才出现。 ![全部：卡片网格 + 搜索/筛选/排序](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy/main/docs/screenshots/01-market-all.png) | | | |---|---| | 包名 | `dsh-plugin-galaxy` | | 宿主 | DeepSeek Harness（cordis 插件系统），Web + Desktop | | 已验证宿主 | `0.1.5-alpha.1` → `0.2.1-alpha.1`，**Web 与桌面版**（Windows/macOS）两代同时支持；差异在运行时兜底，见 [`docs/host-compatibility.md`](docs/host-compatibility.md) | | 依赖 | 无运行时第三方依赖（React/宿主组件由宿主注入）；peer 只有 `cordis` 与 `schemastery` | | 数据 | 文件系统：`/.dsh-galaxy/`，无数据库 | | 遥测 | 无。不采集、不上报任何使用数据 | | 许可 | MIT © 2026 AndyPBI | --- ## 1. 为什么值得装 - **排名是真的**：面板直接读官网目录的综合推荐榜（`ranking.top`）， 卡片带 `#1`、`#2`… 名次与分档徽标，点开有"为什么推荐"的评分构成。 没有把"下载量最高"包装成"推荐"。 - **装完就能用**：安装、更新、启停、卸载、回滚都在面板里，进度/取消/回滚有独立的状态面板； 失败会留下可读原因，而不是让 profile 处于半坏状态。 - **敢动你的 profile**：每次破坏性操作前先做 profile 快照（三文件 + 回滚令牌）， 失败自动回滚；写操作走互斥锁 + 原子写（临时文件 + rename），不靠"应该没问题"。 - **两代宿主都能跑**：宿主在 0.2.x 改了图标命名、设置卡片座位与插件设置项三处契约， 本插件用运行时解析同时兼容 `0.1.5-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-alpha.1`，不是"只支持最新版"。 - **失败隔离**：客户端有 error boundary（面板崩了给恢复面板 + 导出日志）， 服务端每个路由都独立捕获 —— 本插件出问题不会让你的宿主起不来。 ## 2. 功能 ### 2.1 发现与安装 | 能力 | 说明 | |---|---| | 五个筛选 | **全部 / 推荐 / 已安装 / 可更新 / 不兼容**，都是同一套卡片网格；筛选是视图，不是排序 | | 分类筛选 | **官网词表的首个分类（当前=甄选）直接作为 chip 显示在「全部」之后**，一眼可见；完整词表在「分类筛选」下拉里（顺序/标签同官网，数字按目录实时统计，可与状态筛选、搜索叠加）。官网新增或改名分类，面板自动跟随 | | 推荐视图 | 官网 `ranking.top` 前 20（跳过已安装自动补位），每张卡片印名次与分档（S/A/B/C）、评分与"为什么推荐"（编辑推荐条目带 🖊 与理由） | | 搜索 | 名称 / npm 包名 / 分类（标签与 slug 都认）/ 描述 / 作者，同时认**官网展示名**与原始包名 | | 排序 | 名称 / Star 数 / npm 下载量 / 发布时间，各升降序（推荐视图按名次，不排序） | | 卡片信息 | 分类（标签随官网目录下发，中英随界面语种；官网新增/改名分类自动跟随）、★ Star、下载量、版本、来源类型（npm / github / 本地）、bundle 归属、兼容性判定、评论入口 | | 一键安装 | 直接调用宿主 CLI 安装到当前 profile；可选 GitHub 前缀代理 | ![推荐：官网排名前 20](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy/main/docs/screenshots/02-recommended.png) ### 2.2 已安装与生命周期 ![已安装：启停/更新/卸载](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy/main/docs/screenshots/03-installed.png) - 版本、来源类型、bundle 归属一览；**启用 / 停用、更新、卸载**（本插件自己的卡片不提供自我卸载按钮， 避免把自己卸掉后连界面一起消失） - **备注与分组**：给自己的插件写备注、分组，收藏待装条目 - **更新检查**：npm 与 GitHub 两种来源，可强制刷新；本地安装（`file:` tarball）明确标注不检查更新 - **操作面板**：排队 / 运行 / 需要输入 / 完成 / 告警 / 失败，支持取消与回滚 - **更新日志**：按插件查看 release notes（来源可配置） ### 2.3 备份、迁移与自救（设置卡片） - **快照与预设**：把 profile 三文件（`package.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` / `cordis.patch.yml`） 存成命名快照或组合预设，一键恢复；保留数量可配（默认 20） - **WebDAV / GitHub Gist 同步**：把备份推到自己的存储；只在显式点击时外发 - **下载区域 / 发布通道**：选择目录与更新来源的区域与通道 - **一键重启**（默认关闭，见[权限与安全](#权限与安全)）、**自我卸载** - **诊断**：bundle 解析、peer 冲突、重名包清单；**脱敏日志导出**（token/密码打码）用于反馈问题 - **收藏与主题**：收藏待装条目；互斥激活主题型插件 bundle ![插件详情：评分构成与来源](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy/main/docs/screenshots/04-detail-modal.png) ## 3. 安装 > **本插件不在 npm 上**（`registry.npmjs.org/dsh-plugin-galaxy` 不存在）， > 所以 `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-galaxy` 不会成功。请用下面两条路径之一。 ### 路径 A：从 Release 安装（**推荐**，免构建） ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add \ https://github.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy/releases/download/v0.1.34/dsh-plugin-galaxy-0.1.34.tgz ``` ### 路径 B：从源码构建（用于自行审计或改代码） ```bash git clone https://github.com/AndyPBI/dsh-plugin-galaxy.git cd dsh-plugin-galaxy npm ci # 没有 lockfile 的旧版本可用 npm install npm run build # 服务端 tsc → lib/，客户端 tsdown → client/client.js npm pack # 产出 tarball，文件名即下一行要装的那个 # 装进你的 profile（把 web 换成你的 profile 名；版本号用 npm pack 打印出来的） dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-galaxy-0.1.34.tgz ``` ### 装完怎么用 1. **完整重启宿主**（退出并重新启动 `dsh`；只刷新页面不够 —— 插件是在宿主启动时装载的）。 2. 打开**设置对话框 → 插件星系**：打开即是市场。 3. 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-galaxy`，或在面板里用自我卸载。 ### 环境要求 | | | |---|---| | DSH | `>=0.1.5-alpha.1`（含 `0.2.1-alpha.1`）；0.2.x 要求 Node `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0`；桌面版（含 Windows）用应用自带的 pnpm，无需系统 pnpm | | 包管理 | 宿主自带的 pnpm（安装/卸载由 `dsh plugin` 转发给 pnpm） | | 网络 | 拉目录、查 npm 版本、看 GitHub 更新日志需要出站；离线时面板显示缓存与明确错误 | ## 4. 权限与安全 **它读写什么** | 位置 | 用途 | |---|---| | `/package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`、`cordis.patch.yml` | 安装/启停/卸载的写入目标；每次改动前先快照，失败回滚 | | `/.dsh-galaxy/state.json` | 星系自有状态：禁用列表、分组、备注、收藏、通道、区域、GitHub 代理、目录地址 | | `/.dsh-galaxy/presets.json`、`snapshots/.json` | 组合预设与 profile 快照 | | `/.dsh-galaxy/log.ndjson` | 脱敏事件日志（≤256KB，只保留最新一半），可导出用于反馈 | **它访问哪些网络**（全部出站，且都有开关） | 目的地 | 何时 | |---|---| | 插件目录（默认官网 `yhaigc.cn`，可用 `DSHG_REGISTRY_URL` / `catalogUrl` 改） | 拉取目录与推荐榜（带 ETag 复用） | | npm registry（可用 `DSHG_NPM_MIRROR` 改） | 版本、下载量、兼容性事实 | | GitHub API（可用 `DSHG_GITHUB_PROXY` 走你的代理） | 更新日志、仓库信息 | | 你配置的 WebDAV / Gist | **只在你点击同步时** | **它执行什么子进程** - `dsh plugin --profile

add|remove|…`：把 pnpm 参数**原样转发**给宿主 CLI，安装逻辑不自己实现 - Desktop 形态下可选调用宿主提供的 `desktopPnpm` 服务 - 安装子进程有超时与"杀掉后等待落定"的兜底（`DSHG_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS` / `DSHG_KILL_SETTLE_MS`） **它暴露什么** - 所有 HTTP 端点挂在 `/dsh-galaxy` 前缀下（默认只监听宿主已暴露的地址） - **所有变更路由校验同源**（打包桌面版的壳转发请求时会剥离 `Origin`，故"无 `Origin` 但来自回环"同样接受，桌面 UI 才能安装/更新）；破坏性路由（重启、自我卸载、备份下载）额外要求 **loopback** 且拒绝代理转发 - 公开更新 API v1（`/dsh-galaxy/api/v1/*`）供 CI/脚本使用，稳定性标注为 `beta` **不会做的事** - **无遥测**：不采集使用数据、不上报统计、不发任何"心跳" - **不落盘凭据**：WebDAV/Gist 凭据由宿主设置或环境变量提供，插件不写入自己的状态文件；日志导出会脱敏 - **不默认重启宿主**：`allowRestart` 默认未配置即视为关闭；宿由 launchd（或其它 supervisor）托管时， 只有你显式设为 `true` 才允许自重启 —— 避免和托管方抢夺进程所有权 - **无 postinstall 脚本**；发布物只含 `lib/`、`src/`、`client/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`LICENSE` - **失败不改宿主**：客户端 error boundary + 服务端逐路由捕获，本插件异常不影响宿主启动 ## 5. 常见问题 | 现象 | 原因 / 处理 | |---|---| | 设置里看不到「插件星系」 | 装完必须**完整重启宿主**；确认 profile 里已启用（面板「已安装」或 `dsh plugin --profile web list`） | | 目录是旧的 / 有新插件看不到 | 面板右上「刷新」强制重新校验（ETag）；或检查 `catalogUrl` 指向 | | 条数不对 / 没有推荐、没有分类筛选 | 默认目录就是**官网**（`www.yhaigc.cn`）；若该 profile 被指到别处（`DSHG_REGISTRY_URL` 或「设置 → 目录来源」里的值优先），改回官网地址即可 | | 桌面版里看不到「一键重启」 | 设计如此：打包应用拥有进程生命周期，重启由应用负责（Web 形态下 supervisor 未显式允许时同样禁用） | | 更新检查说"不检查更新" | 该插件是从本地 tarball（`file:`）装的，没有可比对的远端版本 | | 兼容性显示"未知" | 尚未拿到该包的 manifest 事实（首次会异步探测，之后按 TTL 缓存） | | 安装失败 | 面板会给出 pnpm 的原始输出；确认网络与 registry，必要时配置 `DSHG_NPM_MIRROR` / `HTTP(S)_PROXY` | | 面板显示"界面崩溃了" | 恢复面板可导出脱敏日志；把日志附在 issue 里即可复现 | ## 6. 文档地图 | 想了解 | 看这里 | |---|---| | 服务端契约：路由、对象、规则、状态文件、错误语义 | [`docs/implementation-contract.md`](docs/implementation-contract.md) | | 客户端契约：槽位、组件结构、文案与布局约束 | [`docs/client-contract.md`](docs/client-contract.md) | | 与官网页面的联动（目录格式、推荐块、深链） | [`docs/site-linkage.md`](docs/site-linkage.md) | | 宿主版本兼容（两代差异与运行时兜底） | [`docs/host-compatibility.md`](docs/host-compatibility.md) | | 宿主补丁清单与核对方式 | [`docs/host-patches.md`](docs/host-patches.md) | | 规范与实现的映射 | [`docs/spec-implementation-mapping.md`](docs/spec-implementation-mapping.md) | | 配置参考（插件配置 / 环境变量 / 状态文件） | [`docs/configuration.md`](docs/configuration.md) | | 开发命令与发版门禁 | [`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md) | | 插件目录数据管线（发现 / 下载 / 分类 / 评分 / 同步到官网） | [`docs/catalog-pipeline.md`](docs/catalog-pipeline.md) | English overview: [`README.en.md`](README.en.md) ## 7. 许可与作者 MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)（Copyright © 2026 AndyPBI）。 - 维护者：AndyPBI · - 仓库与问题反馈： - 第三方归属说明：[`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) > 插件目录与排名由社区站点 提供；本插件与该站点无隶属关系， > 目录地址可用环境变量替换为任何兼容的 catalog。

plugins.description: DSH Desktop 插件：把文件夹拖进 composer，得到它的原生绝对路径（DSH 原生只收文件）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folder-drop

**把文件夹拖进 DeepSeek Harness，得到它的原生绝对路径。**

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![DSH: 0.1.5-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.1.5--rc.2-success.svg?labelColor=4D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> Drag a folder into the DSH Desktop composer and get its real absolute path in the draft — no copy, no upload.

DSH 的 composer 原生只收**文件**。拖放链路只读 `dataTransfer.files`
（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-attachment` 的 `ComposerAttachments`），文件选择器是没有
`webkitdirectory` 的 `<input type="file" multiple>`，粘贴只认 `kind === "file"` 的项；
而浏览器从不把目录内容当 `File` 交出来。结果是：**拖文件夹要么毫无反应，要么在附件栏里
变成一个 0 字节空壳。**

本插件补上这一段：目录拖进来 → 直接把路径写进草稿，交给 agent 自己的文件工具去读。

## 行为

| 拖放内容 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 纯文件 / 纯图片 | **一行不碰**，完全交回 DSH 原生附件链路 —— 附件栏、上传进度、失败重试、图片预览全部保持原样 |
| 含文件夹（可以与文件混拖） | 本插件独占本次拖放：把**每一项**的原生绝对路径按换行追加进当前草稿；同时补一个 synthetic `dragend`，让 DSH 的全屏拖放遮罩正常收起 |
| 含文件夹但取不到路径 | 通过 DSH 自己的 `error` 提示报出失败项名，**绝不静默** |

写入走 DSH 公开的输入门面（不触碰输入框 DOM）：

```js
ctx.conversation.input.for(ctx.sessions.scope(sessionId)).setDraft(text)
```

## 路径从哪里来

按优先级依次尝试：

1. `window.__DSH_DESKTOP_FILE_PATH__.getPathForFile(file)` —— DSH Desktop 的 `preload.cjs` 已用
   `contextBridge` 暴露的 Electron `webUtils`（拿到真实路径的正规入口）
2. `file.path` —— 旧版 Electron 的历史属性
3. `entry.file()` —— 个别 Chromium 版本只在目录项上给这条异步通道
4. `text/uri-list` / `text/plain` 里的 `file://` URL —— 整批兜底

> **时序约束**：Chromium 的 DataTransfer 保护模式让 `items[i].webkitGetAsEntry()`、
> `items[i].getAsFile()`、`dataTransfer.getData()` **只在 drop 事件派发期间有效**。
> 本插件在 drop 处理器的同步段把这些一次性读成快照，异步段只用快照 —— 改代码时别"优化"成惰性读取。

## 安装

```bash
# 从 GitHub 装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chiyu-star499/dsh-folder-drop

# 或从本地目录装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/dsh-folder-drop
```

> **profile 认准 `desktop`**：DSH Desktop（GUI）跑的是 `desktop` profile；`dsh` / `dsh web`
> 默认是 `web`，装进 `web` 对 GUI 无效。
>
> **装完必须重启 DSH Desktop**：配置与插件装载改动不依赖 `patchReload: live`。
>
> `add file:<目录>` 实测是**拷贝安装**（不是软链）——改源码后需要重新 `add` 才会生效。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-folder-drop
```

然后重启 DSH Desktop。插件不写任何状态文件，卸载即彻底还原；profile 的 `package.json`
与 `cordis.patch.yml` 由 `dsh plugin` 自动登记/移除。

## 兼容性

| 组件 | 版本 | 状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DSH Desktop | 2.0.13 | ✅ 真机验收通过 |
| `dsh` 核心 | 0.1.5-rc.2 | ✅ |

依赖的是 `ctx.sessions.scope()` / `ctx.conversation.input.for()` / `.setDraft()` / `.notify()`
这些**公开客户端服务面**。核心里这几处若在后续版本改名，插件需要跟着改（见下方「开发」）。

## 开发

```bash
node ./scripts/build-client.mjs   # src/client.js → lib/client.js（__ModuleLoader__ 外壳）
node ./scripts/smoke.mjs          # 38 条断言：清单契约 / 产物形态 / 纯函数 / drop 行为
```

`lib/client.js` 是**生成物，不要手改**：改 `src/client.js` 后重跑构建，再重新 `add`。

客户端 bundle 的形态是 DSH 客户端模块系统要求的
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` + 惰性 CJS factory；宿主按
`package.json` 的 `exports["./client"]` 解析入口，缺失 `lib/client.js` 会让插件激活直接失败。

## 已知边界

- 只处理 **drop**。文件夹没法粘贴，picker 也选不了目录 —— 那是 DSH 原生缺口，本插件不碰。
- 混拖时文件也走「插路径」而不是「附件上传」：DSH 的 drop 事件无法只拦掉其中一项。要附件上传就纯拖文件。
- 普通浏览器里没有 file-path 桥，拿不到本地路径；这时会明确报错，而不是插入错误的内容。
- 与 [`dsh-drag-and-drop`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-drag-and-drop)、
  [`dsh-drop-to-path`](https://github.com/loudMore/dsh-drop-to-path) 功能重叠，**不要同时安装**。

## 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 chiyu-star499

API 用法参考了 [`dsh-drag-and-drop`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-drag-and-drop)
（BSD-3-Clause）对 DSH 客户端服务面的用法；本插件为独立实现，且不需要它那套 host 侧定位引擎
（DSH Desktop 直接给真实路径）。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: sops+age+git credential vault as a sidebar panel — agents see structure only, plaintext flows only on human click
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-sops-vault English | [中文](README.zh.md) A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that turns a local [sops](https://github.com/getsops/sops) + [age](https://age-encryption.org) + git credential vault into a first-class sidebar panel of the DSH Web GUI — with a hard security boundary between the human and the model. ``` ┌───────────────────────────── DSH Web GUI ─────────────────────────────┐ │ Sidebar: 🔒 Vault panel │ │ · entry rows grouped by prefix, search, git-dirty badge │ │ · detail drawer: per-field 👁 reveal / copy / edit / delete │ │ · live TOTP with countdown ring · entry creation · security audit │ │ · one-click import of browser Authenticator seeds │ │ · kind filter: a TOTP-only live-codes view (authenticator style) │ │ · two-level grouping: group -> company -> entries │ │ · configurable logos per group / company / entry │ │ · access log (values never logged) · zh/en UI │ └──────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ same-origin fetch (Origin-checked) ┌──────────────▼───────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │ Host half: /vault-api route │ shell │ (sops + age + git) │ │ inline sops/git driver ├───────►│ secrets.yaml · .sops.yaml │ └───────────────────────────────┘ └──────────────────────────────┘ The MODEL gets no tool from this plugin. Structure (parsed from the encrypted file, no decryption) is the most an agent-side integration should see; plaintext values only ever flow Host→browser on an explicit human click. ``` ## Screenshots List view (grouped entries, encrypted-field badges, quick actions on hover): ![panel list view](docs/panel-list.png) Detail drawer with live TOTP ring, plus one-click single-field reveal: | Drawer + TOTP | Field revealed on click | |---|---| | ![panel drawer](docs/panel-drawer.png) | ![panel reveal](docs/panel-reveal.png) | ## Why Password-manager GUIs (KeePassXC, Bitwarden) are binary-store, human-only tools: no diff, no audit trail, and wiring an AI agent to them means handing over the master password. A sops+age YAML vault is the opposite: allowlist-encrypted fields keep structure readable, git keeps history, and everything stays scriptable. This plugin gives that stack the GUI it was missing — without opening a plaintext channel to the model. ## Prerequisites Works with both DSH shell generations: `shell.run` (0.1.x) and `shell.execute` + `execution.result` (0.2.x) — feature-detected per call. - Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, pnpm - `sops`, `age`, `git` on the host PATH (`brew install sops age`) - A vault repository at `~/Vault` (or `config.vaultDir`) — easiest created by **[sops-vault-kit](https://github.com/skyzhao1223/sops-vault-kit)** (`./install.sh`), containing: - `secrets.yaml` — sops-encrypted YAML; entries live under a top-level `systems:` map - `.sops.yaml` — creation rules using the **allowlist** mode (`unencrypted_regex`: everything encrypted except explicitly public field names like `url`/`appid`/`env`/`owner`/`note`) - an age key reachable by sops (default: `~/Library/Application Support/sops/age/keys.txt` on macOS, `~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt` on Linux, or `SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE`) - `dsh web` (the host half needs the `webServer` and `shell` services) No other CLI or daemon is required — the plugin drives `sops` and `git` directly. ## Install & mount ```sh git clone https://github.com/skyzhao1223/dsh-plugin-sops-vault && cd dsh-plugin-sops-vault pnpm install pnpm build # tsc (node half + types) + tsdown (browser bundle) pnpm test # 127 unit tests pnpm verify # load-path check against the built artifact dsh web --patch "$PWD/cordis.yml" ``` The overlay inserts one row: ```yaml - insert: - id: vault-panel name: './lib/index.js' # config: # vaultDir: ~/Vault # leading ~ is expanded # sopsBin: sops # resolved via PATH # gitBin: git # timeoutMs: 15000 ``` For a published install, replace `name` with the bare package name after installing it into the dsh tree. Refresh the browser after (re)building the client bundle. Mounting note: `--patch` is a **global** dsh option — `dsh web --patch ` works; do not sandwich other web options before it (e.g. `dsh web --no-open --patch …` fails to parse). The browser opens automatically; close the extra tab if unwanted. ## API One prefix route on the DSH web server; every response is `{ok, data|error}` JSON. | Endpoint | Method | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `/vault-api/meta` | GET | whole-vault structure, parsed from the encrypted file **without decrypting** | | `/vault-api/reveal` | POST | one field's plaintext (`{name, field}`) — human-click only | | `/vault-api/totp` | POST | current 6-digit code, computed host-side from the stored seed | | `/vault-api/totp-batch` | POST | live codes for many entries from **one** decryption (`{names?}`) — backs the 动态码 view | | `/vault-api/audit` | GET | allowlist/leak audit report | | `/vault-api/audit-log` | GET | tail of the access log | | `/vault-api/set` / `rm` / `create` / `save` | POST | field write / delete / new entry / git commit | | `/vault-api/rename` / `sort` | POST | rename one entry / re-sort all entries | | `/vault-api/logos` | GET / POST | read the logo config / set or remove one logo (`{scope: group\|sub\|entry, key, logo}`) | | `/vault-api/logo` | POST | upload a raster image into `/logos/` (`{name, dataBase64}`) | | `/vault-api/logo/` | GET | the image bytes, for `` (raster only, traversal-refusing) | ### Logos for groups, companies and entries `/logos.json` (plaintext metadata, git-tracked like `systems.md`) maps a group (`工作`), a company sub-group (`工作/金山办公`) or a full entry name to one logo value. Logos live OUTSIDE the encrypted document on purpose: they are presentation, not credentials, so no `.sops.yaml` allowlist change and no vault-wide re-encryption is needed. A value takes one of four forms — an emoji or ≤2 characters (rendered as the avatar itself), a bare raster file name served from `/logos/` (offline-safe), an `http(s)` URL, or an inline `data:image/...;base64,` URI. An entry with no logo inherits its company's, then its group's. Renaming an entry (or a whole company prefix) carries its logo across; deleting an entry forgets it. Uploads are capped at 512 KB, must sniff as PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/ICO, and are stored under the sniffed extension. **SVG is refused**: served from this origin as a document it could run script in the vault's own origin. The file route also sends `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; sandbox` and refuses any name that is not a bare raster filename. A remote URL works, but that host then sees your IP and when you opened the panel — the UI says so where you enter one. | `/vault-api/dirty` | GET | git dirty state | | `/vault-api/import-scan` | GET | TOTP entries found in the browser's Authenticator extension (`?lang=zh|en` localizes reasons) | | `/vault-api/import-apply` | POST | write the selected entries into the vault (`{items:[{id,name,username,url,note,overwrite}]}`) | ### Importing from the Chrome Authenticator extension The 导入动态码 / *Import codes* toolbar button reads the [Authenticator](https://github.com/Authenticator-Extension/Authenticator) extension straight off disk: a built-in read-only LevelDB parser (`src/host/leveldb.ts` — WAL log records, SSTable blocks and a from-scratch Snappy decompressor, no native dependency) recovers the extension's `OTPStorage` entries from `/{Sync,Local} Extension Settings//`, whichever area the extension's own `UserSettings.storageLocation` points at. Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Arc and Opera are auto-discovered on macOS/Linux/Windows; `config.browserDataDir` adds a non-standard user-data root. The scan returns metadata only (issuer, account, type, digits, period, seed **length**). The

plugins.description: DSH plugin: read-only ecosystem health panel - bundle / patch / skill / upgrade / decoupling diagnosis in one view | DSH 插件：只读生态健康面板，六类体检一屏看完
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ecosystem-panel

> **English**: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

> 给 DSH 实例装一块**只读**的生态总览面板：插件有没有加载、补丁还在不在、技能 frontmatter 有没有写坏、
> 依赖有没有升级风险 —— 一屏看完，🟢🟡🔴 三色。
>
> 它**只诊断，不动手**：不装包、不卸包、不升级、不改配置、不写任何被体检对象。

侧边栏底部「设置」齿轮上方会多一个图标按钮，点开就是面板；服务端只暴露一个只读接口：

```
GET /api/dsh-ecosystem-panel/state
```

## 设计依据

本组件是「[ops-handoff-design](https://github.com/kira905/ops-handoff-design)」所述运维体系的一个实现，
设计依据（对应文档仓约定的固定四问）：

- **它为什么存在、边界在哪** → 见《只读监控面板的设计纪律》**§1 面板要回答的问题**、**§2 显示纪律（不可探测 + 原因）**；本组件的六类体检正是那份纪律的一次落地
- **它与宿主版本的兼容区间** → 见《多机交接与云中继》**§4.5「兼容性要求」**（另见本 README 第 6 节「兼容性」）
- **本组件特有的坑与实测** → 见本 README「已知限制」一节；另见《只读监控面板的设计纪律》**§7 设计教训汇总**（三次"静默不报"的来历）
- **文档仓地址** → Gitee（镜像）<https://gitee.com/kira905/ops-handoff-design>
  ｜ GitHub（主）<https://github.com/kira905/ops-handoff-design>
  （文档仓的组件索引表回指本仓；两仓互链、版本各自独立）

> 设计稿里不写具体仓库地址（写死即死链），实现清单统一收在文档仓的组件索引表里——本仓只负责回链章节。

---

## 1. 它看什么（六类 + 一个可选类）

| 类目 | 数据来源 | 判定 | 数据缺失时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① **bundle 插件** | profile 的 `package.json`（`dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies`）+ 各包实体 `package.json` + 宿主首页的 boot 清单 | 实体在不在 / 声明版本与实体版本是否漂移 / 声明了 client 能力但 boot 里没加载 = 🔴 | boot 抓不到 ⇒ 显示「加载状态未知」（黄），**不当作已加载** |
| ② **patch insert 插件** | profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `insert` 条目 | 实体目录能否解析到（profile 层 → 共享 fallback 层）；被 `disabled` 的标黄 | YAML 解析器不可用 ⇒ 明说「不可解析」，不当成空清单 |
| ③ **补丁健康** | **你提供的补丁清单**（外置 JSON） | 逐条做特征串扫描：`contains` 缺一个 = 定制被冲掉（黄）；目标文件没了 = 🔴；`notContains` 命中 = 残留 | 清单没配 ⇒ 显示「未配置 ⇒ 不可判定」（黄），**不显示"0 个补丁"** |
| ④ **技能** | 数据根下 `skills/*/SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter | 缺 `name` / `description`、frontmatter 解析失败 | 目录不存在 ⇒ 报 `skillsDirOk=false` |
| ⑤ **升级体检** | 本地实体版本 + npm registry 最新版（24h 文件缓存）+ 你的规则表文案 | 颜色由**外部只读 CLI** 判定；本面板只渲染（拿不到就显示「档位不可用」+ 原因，**绝不猜颜色**） | 没配 CLI ⇒ 每行 `unknown` + 原因 |
| ⑥ **解耦健康** | **你提供的外部检查脚本**（动态 import 复用其导出函数，不复制判定） | R1 静态 import 宿主符号 = 🔴；动态导入/依赖未归零 = 🟡 | 没配脚本 ⇒ 一条 🟡 + 配置指引 |
| ⑦ **跨表准入一致性**（可选） | **你提供的外部校验器** | 三态显式枚举 `ok / fail / unavailable`；`asOf` 缺失即判 `unavailable` | 没配 ⇒ `unavailable`（**不是** 0/0/0 绿） |

**设计红线（贯穿全仓）**：读不到的东西一律显示「不可探测 + 原因」，**绝不显示 0、绝不假装全绿**。
面板 meta 里还带一份**配置来源自证**（每个配置键到底是从 CLI / 环境变量 / 配置文件 / 自动探测 / 默认值
哪一层读到的），换机器排障时先看它。

## 2. 前置条件

- 一个 DSH 实例（web profile），主包线见 §6 兼容性表
- Node ≥ 18.17（用到了内置 `fetch` / `AbortSignal.timeout`）
- **YAML 解析器（`js-yaml`）**：由宿主 profile 的依赖链提供（通常随主包自带）。解析不到时 ②④
  两类会显式显示「不可解析」，其它四类不受影响
- 可选的三个/四个外部脚本（解耦检查、档位 CLI、跨表校验器、适配层一致性校验器）——**没有也能跑**，
  对应类目会降级；本仓不附带这些脚本（它们属于你自己的体检体系）

## 3. 安装三步

```bash
# ① 装进 profile（npm 包名：@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel）
npm install @kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel --prefix "<数据根>/profiles/web"
#   离线 / 要改源码时：把本仓 clone 到
#   "<数据根>/profiles/web/node_modules/@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel"

# ② 注册：profile 的 package.json 里
#      "dependencies": 加一条  "@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel": "0.4.4"
#      "dsh.profile.bundles": 数组里加 "@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel"

# ③ 重启 DSH（本插件没有热加载），然后打开 GUI：侧边栏齿轮上方应出现面板按钮
```

验证（不依赖 GUI）：

```bash
node "<数据根>/profiles/web/node_modules/@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel/scripts/verify-state.mjs"
# 终端里应打印六类结果 + 配置来源自证
```

> 包已发布到 npm（`@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel`）：`npm install` 只装它自己（`dependencies` 为空，
> `js-yaml` 由宿主 profile 提供）。早期版本只发 Release、不进 npm；本版（`0.4.4`）起以 scope 包名发布。

## 4. 配置

优先级（**每个键独立**）：`显式传入（插件 config / 调用参数）` > `环境变量` > `配置文件` > `自动探测` > `内置默认`。

### 4.1 环境变量

| 变量 | 作用 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_HOME` | DSH 数据根 | `os.homedir()/.dsh`（`DSH_HOME` 同效、优先级更低） |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_PROFILE` | profile 名 | `web` |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_WEB_URL` | 本实例基址（抓 boot 清单用） | `DSH_WEB_URL`，否则 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_TOOLS_DIR` | 外部工具目录（**不自动探测**） | 空 ⇒ 依赖它的类目降级 |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_MAIN_NM` | 宿主主包 node_modules | 按全局 npm 布局探测；探测不到即判不可用 |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_CONFIG` | 配置文件 JSON 路径 | 空 |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_CACHE_FILE` | 升级体检缓存文件 | `<数据根>/ecosystem-panel-upgrade-cache.json` |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_DECOUPLING_SCRIPT` | 解耦检查脚本 | `<toolsDir>/check-decoupling.mjs` |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_TRIAGE_CLI` | 升级档位只读 CLI | `<toolsDir>/upgrade-triage-cli.mjs` |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_REGISTRY_AUDIT_LIB` | 跨表准入校验器 | `<toolsDir>/registry-audit.mjs` |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_HOST_ADAPTER_SYNC` | 适配层一致性校验器（可选） | `<toolsDir>/sync-host-adapter.mjs` |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_PATCH_MANIFEST_FILE` | 补丁清单 JSON | 空 ⇒ ③ 显示「未配置」 |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_UPGRADE_RULES_FILE` | 升级规则表 JSON | 空 |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_BREAKING_SYMBOLS_FILE` | 断裂符号表 JSON | 空 |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_LABELS_FILE` | 包名 → 一句话简介 JSON | 空（没登记的包只是没有简介） |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_DISABLED_GROUPS` | 整组停用的类目（逗号分隔） | 全开 |
| `DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_WEBSERVER_SERVICE` | 宿主 web server 服务名 | `webServer` |

### 4.2 配置文件与示例

`examples/` 下有五份可直接抄的示例：

| 文件 | 对应配置 |
|---|---|
| `ecosystem-panel.config.example.json` | 总览（各键的位置与形态） |
| `patch-manifest.example.json` | ③ 补丁清单（`checks` / `special` / `retired` 三种形态都有例子，字符串里可用 `${HOME}` 占位符） |
| `upgrade-rules.example.json` | ⑤ 规则表文案（`verdict` 只是文案分类，不决定颜色） |
| `breaking-symbols.example.json` | 宿主主包断裂符号参考底表 |
| `labels.example.json` | 包名 → 一句话简介 |

用法：

```bash
DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_CONFIG=/path/to/my.config.json   # 指向你抄过去改的那份
```

### 4.3 降级语义（重要）

- **没配 ≠ 没有**：③ 未配清单时显示「未配置 ⇒ 不可判定」，不会显示"0 个补丁全绿"；
  ⑥⑦ 与 ⑤ 同理（都带配置指引）。
- **抓不到**：宿主首页抓不到 boot 清单时，① 只把"未知"标黄，并把抓取错误原文放进 `meta.bootError`。
- **停用**：确实不需要某一类，就把它写进 `disabledGroups` —— 面板会显示一条「已按配置停用」的提示项
  （比静默消失更清楚，且不计入汇总）。
- 配置解析失败（比如清单 JSON 坏了）不会让面板崩：`meta.configErrors` 里能看到原因，该键回落默认。

## 5. 界面

- 六类各占一张标签卡（Tab），Tab 上的小圆点 = 该类最差状态（红 > 黄 > 绿）
- 点「刷新」会重新取数；`GET /state?refresh=1` 强制重查 npm 最新版（否则 24h 缓存）
- 颜色：🟢 正常 / 🟡 风险或不可判定 / 🔴 异常（比如 patch insert 的实体缺失）
- 面板底部说明与标题可由配置覆盖（`text.title` / `text.note` / `text.tabs`，服务端经 `meta.ui` 下发）

## 6. 兼容性

| 宿主主包线 | 状态 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| **`0.2.0-rc.2`** | ✅ **已端到端实测（2026-10-16）** | **本版 `peerDependencies` 声明的区间基线**：在隔离实例（独立数据根 + 端口 3090）上真装真跑 —— 本仓 `scripts/verify-state.mjs`（只读六类体检）**rc=0 跑通**，读到了该实例的数据根与配置来源；客户端半 `client.js` 出现在实例启动 HTML 的插件资源清单里 |
| `0.2.x` 后续版本 | ⚠️ **未实测，不作承诺**（区间上界 `<0.3.0`） | — |
| `0.1.1-rc.2` / `0.1.5` 线 | ⚠️ 历史静态核对（**本版起 `peerDependencies` 不再声明 0.1.x**） | 见 `v0.4.3` 及之前的本节 |
| ⚠️ 升级体检 / 解耦健康 两卡的**读数** | ⚠️ **未在 0.2.0 实例上校准** | 0.1.5 起客户端资源改成"名册制 + 合并 URL"，两卡是否读全未验证 —— **最可能的表现是读数偏保守，不是崩溃** |
| 其它 | ❓ 未知 | 需自测 |

## 7. 已知限制

1. **js-yaml 依赖宿主提供** —— 解析不到时 ②④ 两类显示「不可解析」（不假绿），但也就查不了了。
2. **boot 清单靠抓宿主首页**的内联 `__DSH_BOOT__` 段 —— 宿主若改了这个投影，① 的"加载状态"就变成未知（黄）。
3. **③ 的判定完全取决于你给的清单**：本仓**不内嵌**任何环境的补丁清单，清单写错就会报错。
4. **⑤ 的颜色不来自本面板**：它来自你配置的档位 CLI（唯一判定源）。本面板只渲染，绝不猜颜色。
5. **⑥⑦ 依赖外部脚本**，本仓不带这些脚本；未配置时对应类目只会显示降级提示。
6. **升级体检会访问 npm registry**（`registry.npmjs.org`），结果缓存 24h；离线时显示"远端查询失败"并继续用缓存。
7. **只读**：面板没有任何写操作入口（唯一写文件的是升级体检自己的缓存）。
8. **前端只支持 web platform**（`dsh.client.inject` 为空，不依赖任何 client 包）。
9. **界面文案为中文**，可通过 `text` 配置覆盖；没有内置多语言切换。
10. **未做移动端专门优化**（面板宽度自适应，但按钮/触摸交互没专门测过）。

## 8. 仓结构

```
lib/index.js          服务端：注册只读 route
lib/state.js          六类聚合逻辑（每个数据源都走配置层 + 显式降级）
lib/upgrade.js        ⑤ 升级体检（本地事实 + npm 缓存 → 外部只读 CLI → 渲染）
lib/config.js         配置层（优先级解析 + 占位符展开 + 来源自证）
lib/host-protocol.js  宿主协议常量（本插件只用 webServer 一个服务名）
lib/client.js         浏览器端：侧边栏按钮 + 面板（零 import）
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch（把插件挂到宿主）

scripts/test-fixture.mjs   干净临时路径上的端到端夹具（含缺数据降级断言）

```

## 9. 自测

```bash
node scripts/verify-source.mjs .    # 语法 + 配置层行为 + 脱敏扫描（发布前必跑）
node scripts/test-fixture.mjs       # 端到端夹具：不需要任何真实安装，全在临时目录里造
node scripts/verify-state.mjs       # 对当前实例只读体检（打印六类 + 配置来源）
```

`test-fixture.mjs` 会现场造一个最小数据根（假 profile / 假插件实体 / 假技能 / 四个外部工具 stub），
断言六类都能跑出结果，并专门验证「缺数据必显式降级」。

## 10. 相关组件

plugins.description: A safe, bounded, read-only perception layer for AI agents to observe administrator-defined JSON APIs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-worldsense

> **WorldSense lets DeepSeek Harness safely read administrator-defined JSON
> APIs without turning the agent into an unrestricted HTTP client.**
>
> 给 DSH Agent 一个安全、只读、受限的"现实感知层"。

A safe, bounded, read-only perception layer for AI agents. Agents choose what
configured source to observe. They do not choose where arbitrary network
requests go.

```text
World → AI  = WorldSense   (this plugin: the agent observes the world)
AI → World  = Human Intent (a sibling plugin: humans authorize changes)
```

核心口号：**Give AI the ability to read the world.**

中文说法：管理员定义"世界有哪些窗口"；Agent 决定"现在看哪个窗口"；
Agent 不能自己在墙上再开一个洞。

---

## What it is

WorldSense gives a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent six read-only tools for
observing **generic structured world state** — the long tail of JSON APIs that
are worth reading but not worth a dedicated plugin:

deployment APIs, feature-flag state, service registries, status pages, GitHub
project stats, release info, CI status, queue depth, inventory, internal
platform state, cloud control-plane read APIs, business numbers, any custom
JSON API (v0.1: **GET + JSON only**).

If a system deserves a dedicated plugin (metrics/dashboards/alerts →
`dsh-grafana`; logs/search/trace evidence → `dsh-searchops`), use the
dedicated plugin. If you just want the agent to **safely read one structured
status API**, that is WorldSense's job.

### 中文定位

WorldSense 给 DSH Agent 一个读取现实世界状态的通用感知层：

- **安全（safe）**—— 目的地由管理员配置，Agent 永远无法指定任意 URL、主机、端口、协议、路径、HTTP 方法、Header 或凭证。
- **受限（bounded）**—— 每一层都有预算：响应字节数、字段数量、值长度、diff 条目数、历史条数；超限永远如实标注 `truncated`。
- **可追溯（traceable）**—— 每次读取都是一个带来源（provenance）的 `WorldObservation`：source、endpoint、GET url、observedAt、SHA-256 contentHash。

## Why not just curl?

Three questions this plugin exists to answer:

**Why can't the agent fetch any URL?** An agent with an arbitrary-URL tool is
an unauthenticated proxy that can be steered anywhere — including localhost
admin panels, cloud metadata endpoints, and internal services — by prompt
injection in any text it reads. SSRF is not a hypothetical for an agent
runtime; it is the default behavior of "give the model a fetch tool". In
WorldSense the agent only ever names a **source id** and an **endpoint id**;
the destination is resolved from administrator configuration, and the resolved
URL's origin is re-verified against the configured origin on every request.

**Why admin-defined sources?** Because the trust boundary has to live
somewhere. The administrator decides which windows into the world exist
(base URL, fixed paths, whitelisted query parameters, named field aliases,
auth mode). The agent decides which window to look through, right now. The
agent never gets to punch a new hole in the wall — there is no tool parameter
for a URL, host, port, protocol, path, method, header or credential, and the
test suite enforces that structurally.

**Why snapshots and provenance?** Because evidence without provenance is weak
evidence. Every observation carries its source, endpoint, observation time and
a deterministic SHA-256 content hash; `worldsense_snapshot` saves the
sanitized observation to local SQLite, and `worldsense_diff` computes a
deterministic structural diff between two snapshots — so "what changed since
yesterday" is a plugin computation, not something the LLM eyeballs. Observation
≠ truth (see [docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md](docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md)): the remote API
may be stale, wrong, partial or malicious, and WorldSense never hides that.

## The six tools (v0.1)

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `worldsense_sources` | List configured sources/endpoints/params/field aliases (no secrets) |
| `worldsense_status` | Reachability, latency, HTTP status of one source endpoint (no body) |
| `worldsense_read` | Observe now → one bounded `WorldObservation` (nothing persisted) |
| `worldsense_snapshot` | Observe now + save sanitized result to local SQLite, returns `snapshotId` |
| `worldsense_history` | Bounded metadata listing of saved snapshots (filters: source, endpoint, before/after) |
| `worldsense_diff` | Deterministic structural JSON diff between two snapshot ids |

All of them are strictly read-only towards the outside world: the HTTP client
is GET-only **by construction** (the method is a constant in the code; no
config, argument or internal path can change it), redirects are never
followed, and every response is byte-capped while streaming.

## Quick start

```bash
npm install
npm test        # 118 tests, fully offline
npm run demo    # local end-to-end demo: read → snapshot → change → snapshot → diff
```

Configure sources in Settings → Plugins (or hand-write JSON — both forms are
canonicalized):

```json
{
  "sources": [
    {
      "id": "github-dsh-grafana",
      "type": "http-json",
      "baseUrl": "https://api.github.com",
      "auth": { "type": "bearer", "credential": "GITHUB_TOKEN" },
      "endpoints": {
        "repository": {
          "path": "/repos/guhanfei-ai/dsh-grafana",
          "fields": {
            "stars": "/stargazers_count",
            "forks": "/forks_count",
            "issues": "/open_issues_count",
            "updatedAt": "/updated_at"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`auth.credential` is a **credential-store reference**, never a secret value —
the token itself lives in the DSH credential store and is resolved at request
time, going straight into the Authorization header: never into tool output,
errors, logs, snapshots or the database.

Full schema: [docs/SOURCE_CONFIG.md](docs/SOURCE_CONFIG.md) · runnable
examples: [examples/](examples/).

## Three real scenarios

### A — Deployment state

Source `prod-platform`, endpoint `deployment-status` →
`service=payment-api, version=1.8.4, replicas=12, healthy=12`.
The agent can answer *"what version is payment-api running in production
right now?"* — with a content hash and an observation time attached.

### B — GitHub reality feedback

Source `github-dsh-grafana`, endpoint `repository` →
`stars, forks, issues, updatedAt`. *"What real-world feedback does the project
have right now?"* One generic JSON adapter — no dedicated GitHub plugin, no
browser, no scraping.

### C — Internal business state

Source `business-api`, endpoint `daily-summary` →
`orders, revenue, failedPayments, activeUsers`. The agent observes business
reality through the same confined pipeline as everything else.

## Design philosophy

```text
Connectivity ≠ Permission        Data ≠ Evidence        Evidence ≠ Truth
```

```text
World → Configured Source → Bounded Observation → Provenance → Evidence → Agent Reasoning
```

WorldSense does the deterministic work — fetch, validate, select, redact,
bound, hash, persist, diff. The model does the reasoning — understand, explain,
decide what to inspect next. The plugin never judges: it reports
`readyReplicas=8, desiredReplicas=10` and lets the agent conclude; it never
calls another LLM, never summarizes via AI, never performs "AI root-cause
analysis". **WorldSense = deterministic perception. LLM = reasoning.**

And in the wider picture (deliberately decoupled repos, complementary ideas):

```text
WorldSense answers:  "What may the agent observe?"
Human Intent answers: "What may the agent change?"
```

```text
        WORLD
          │
          ▼
     WorldSense
          │
          ▼
        Agent
          │
    proposed action
          │
          ▼
    Human Intent
          │
          ▼
        Human
          │
    authorization
          │
          ▼
        WORLD
```

WorldSense **does not authorize write actions** — writes belong to Human
Intent.

## Honest non-guarantees

- WorldSense cannot guarantee detection of every secret (redaction is a
  best-effort key/pattern heuristic, not a DLP product).
- WorldSense does not make an untrusted API trustworthy.
- WorldSense does not prevent malicious content from appearing inside
  otherwise allowed data (treat remote content as untrusted data).
- WorldSense does not provide complete prompt-injection protection.
- WorldSense does not provide distributed snapshot consistency (snapshots are
  local observations, not a consensus log).
- WorldSense does not authorize write actions.

plugins.description: Cryptographically bind human authorization to the exact action an AI agent is about to execute.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-human-intent

**Human intent verification and cryptographic action authorization for AI agents.**

> AI can propose an action.
> Only a human can authorize it.

```
Agent proposes Action
        ↓
Canonicalize Action
        ↓
Hash Exact Intent
        ↓
Human sees exact Action
        ↓
Human verifies (WebAuthn: Touch ID / Windows Hello / passkey)
        ↓
Cryptographically sign Intent
        ↓
Generate Intent Receipt
        ↓
Verify exact Action binding
        ↓
Execute
```

## Why

AI agents can increasingly execute real-world actions: delete data, deploy
services, spend money, send messages. An agent having the **capability** to
run a tool does not mean a human granted the **authority** to run it.

`Capability != Authority.`

Existing human-in-the-loop mechanisms usually verify a fuzzy fact — "a human
touched the sensor" — and then hand the agent a blanket `verified = true`,
often valid for a window of time. Nothing binds the approval to the exact
action. An approval obtained for `rm -rf ./test-data` silently authorizes
`rm -rf ./production-data`.

dsh-human-intent closes that gap. Every authorization is:

- **Exact-action-bound** — the approval is hashed and signed over the precise
  tool, target and arguments; any mutation invalidates it.
- **Cryptographically signed** — WebAuthn (platform authenticator, passkey,
  or security key) with full server-side verification.
- **One-shot** — an authorization authorizes exactly one execution.
- **Expiring** — requests and receipts carry a short validity window.
- **Auditable** — every transition is recorded in a local append-only log.

This project is **not** a fingerprint-identification system and does not
identify a specific natural person. WebAuthn platform authenticators
(Touch ID / Windows Hello / passkeys) prove that *the holder of a registered
credential* performed a user-verification gesture. That proof is what gets
bound to the action. See [Security Model](#security-model).

## How It Works

1. The agent (or a `tools/pre-execute` policy hook) proposes an
   **IntentRequest**: tool, operation, target, arguments, risk, reason.
2. The request is canonically serialized (RFC 8785 JCS) and hashed:
   `intentHash = SHA-256(canonical intent)`.
3. The human opens the approval page and sees the **exact action**.
4. Approving triggers a WebAuthn ceremony whose **challenge is the
   intentHash itself** — the authenticator signs the bytes of the action.
5. The server fully verifies the assertion (challenge, origin, RP ID,
   public key signature, counter, user-verification flag) and issues an
   **IntentReceipt**.
6. Before execution, the receipt is consumed: the action is re-hashed and
   must match, the signature is re-verified against the stored credential,
   and the one-shot consumption marker is checked. Only then does the tool
   run — exactly once, for exactly that action.

## Quick Start

Requirements: Node.js ≥ 20.11.

```bash
npm install
npm run verify        # build + lint + tests + http smoke test
npm run demo          # interactive acceptance scenarios A–E
```

Demo walkthrough (the part you show people):

```bash
npm run demo
```

- No passkey yet? The browser opens and you register one (Touch ID on macOS,
  Windows Hello on Windows).
- Pick a scenario; the agent proposes a destructive command, the browser
  shows the exact action, you approve or deny, and the terminal prints the
  cryptographic outcome — including the mutation, replay and expiry attacks
  being rejected.

Run the approval server standalone:

```bash
npm run serve                       # http://localhost:8787
node bin/dsh-human-intent.js serve --port 9000 --data-dir ./data
```

Inspect a receipt (validates structure, integrity and signature):

```bash
node bin/dsh-human-intent.js inspect receipt.json
```

Read the audit log:

```bash
node bin/dsh-human-intent.js audit
```

## DSH Plugin

Inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH), the plugin provides:

- `human_intent_request` — propose an action, wait for the human, receive
  an IntentReceipt (or an explicit denial).
- `human_intent_verify` — verify a receipt authorizes one exact action
  before executing it.
- `human_intent_status` — enforcement status.
- `tools/pre-execute` policy enforcement for `protectedTools`.
- A settings slot and a Better Sidebar approval panel (WebAuthn in the DSH
  web UI), plus a loopback API under `/human-intent/api`.

```json
{
  "protectedTools": ["shell.exec", "kubectl.*"],
  "rules": [{ "tool": "shell.exec", "risk": "high" }]
}
```

Glob semantics: `shell.*` matches one dot-segment (`shell.exec`, not
`shell.exec.sub`); `shell.**` spans segments. Exact names always work.

Local development:

```bash
npm install
npm run build:client
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/Users/you/dsh-human-intent
```

> The DSH client UI must be served from `localhost` for WebAuthn to be
> available, and the DSH host origin must be listed in `allowedOrigins`.

## Configuration

| Option | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Enforce human intent for protected tools. |
| `protectedTools` | `[]` | Tool names / dot-globs requiring authorization. |
| `rules` | `[]` | `{ tool, risk }` rules combining protection and risk level. |
| `rpID` | `localhost` | WebAuthn relying-party ID. |
| `allowedOrigins` | `http://localhost:<port>` | WebAuthn origin allowlist. |
| `requestTtlMs` | `120000` | Human decision window. |
| `dataDir` | (memory) | Directory for `credentials.json` + `audit.jsonl`. |

## IntentRequest

```ts
interface IntentRequest {
  version: "0.1"
  requestId: string          // unique per request
  intentHash: string         // SHA-256 over the canonical intent
  nonce: string              // 256-bit unguessable, one per request
  action: {
    tool: string             // e.g. "shell.exec"
    operation?: string
    target?: string          // e.g. "namespace/prod/pod/foo"
    arguments: object        // exact arguments
  }
  context?: {
    description?: string
    reason?: string
    risk?: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical"
  }
  agent?: { id?: string; name?: string }
  session?: { id?: string }
  issuedAt: string           // ISO 8601
  expiresAt: string          // ISO 8601
}
```

## IntentReceipt

```ts
interface IntentReceipt {
  kind: "IntentReceipt"
  version: "0.1"
  requestId: string
  intentHash: string          // the action this receipt authorizes
  decision: "approved" | "denied"
  intent: IntentRequest       // embedded, integrity-checked
  authenticator: { type: "webauthn"; credentialId: string }
  verification: { method: "webauthn"; userVerified: boolean }
  signedAt: string
  expiresAt: string           // same window as the request
  nonce: string
  assertion?: { /* raw WebAuthn assertion for re-verification */ }
  deniedReason?: string
}
```

Receipts serialize, verify and audit (`docs/PROTOCOL.md`).

## Security Model

What this project guarantees, precisely:

1. **Action binding.** Approving `tool=A, args=X` produces a receipt that
   cannot authorize `tool=A, args=Y` or `tool=B, args=X`. The intentHash
   covers tool, operation, target, arguments, nonce, requestId and the
   validity window.
2. **Signature coverage.** The WebAuthn challenge *is* the intentHash, so
   the authenticator's signature covers the exact action bytes.
3. **Full server-side verification.** Challenge, origin allowlist, RP ID,
   credential public key (COSE/ES256 or RS256), signature, signature
   counter (clone detection) and the user-verification flag are all
   verified with `@simplewebauthn/server`. No client-provided
   `verified: true` is ever trusted.
4. **One-shot consumption.** A consumed receipt is rejected on reuse — in
   memory and, when a data dir is configured, across restarts via the
   audit log.
5. **Expiry.** Requests and receipts share a short window; after it, only a
   fresh human authorization works.
6. **Explicit denial.** Denials are first-class outcomes the agent can read.

What this project does **not** claim:

- It does not identify which natural person is enrolled on the device.
  WebAuthn proves a registered credential holder verified — see
  [docs/THREAT_MODEL.md](docs/THREAT_MODEL.md) for the

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-basket · 插件收纳篮 [English](#english) · MIT 一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)（DSH）Web 客户端插件： **给日渐繁多的插件按钮一个归宿。** 屏幕最右侧一条细长把手，鼠标一碰滑出抽屉—— 里面按分组、来源、搜索、最近使用排好你装过的每一个插件按钮，最常用的那几个还能一键贴回原位。 > **装上就生效，不需要改动任何一个插件。** > 它不修改第三方插件的代码，不要求插件作者适配，也不动你的 profile 配置。 ## 📸 效果 **同一个输入栏，收纳前 / 收纳后** —— 插件照常在跑，只是入口不再挤在工具行： ![收纳前后对比](assets/02-composer.png) 它长在应用最右侧。抽屉里按「你添加的」和「DSH 自带」两块分开，每条带来源标签与收纳状态，可搜索、可分组、可拖拽排序： 收起态就是右缘这样一条细长把手（鼠标碰一下、或点一下就能拉开）： `设置 → 插件收纳篮` 里还有一张更宽松的管理页，和抽屉共享同一份状态： ## ❓ 它解决什么问题 DSH 的插件都往同一排位置塞按钮：输入框工具行、会话标题栏、左侧栏底部。 装到第五个插件时，那排按钮已经开始互相挤，图标又都长得差不多，只能靠 hover 提示认人。 插件收纳篮把这些按钮**收拢**起来：插件照常在跑，浮窗照常能开，只是入口不再散落一地。 ## ✨ 核心特性 - **零改造接管**：自动发现各席位上的第三方插件按钮，一个插件都不用改 - **右侧细长把手**：收起时只占屏幕最右 9px（一根 9 × 420 的极窄竖条，中间一个向左的折线）；悬停或点击滑出，移开自动收起 - **自动识别**：名字直接读按钮的 `aria-label`，图标直接复用按钮里的原 SVG，**开箱就是中文名和原图标** - **状态会跟着走**：原按钮上的角标数字与运行圆点会同步到抽屉条目上（按类名语义识别，不写死任何插件的类名） - **收纳 / 贴回**：一键把按钮从原位收进抽屉，或贴回它**原本的席位**（标题栏的回标题栏，输入栏的回输入栏） - **分类 · 搜索 · 最近使用 · 常用**：抽屉内分区展示，支持按名字 / id / 来源搜索，标星常用 - **绝不动系统按钮**：自动区分「第三方插件按钮」与「DSH 自带按钮」，自带的一律不碰（也可右键强制收纳） - **来源一眼可辨**：每条都带来源标签（`插件`＝你自己装的 / `系统`＝DSH 自带的 / `未识别`），抽屉里也用「你添加的插件」与「DSH 自带（默认不碰）」两块分开，顶部还能按来源筛选 - **设置页也有入口**：`设置 → 插件收纳篮` 是一张宽松的管理页（按分组列出全部条目、每条直接选分组、系统项折叠在下面、导出/导入配置）。它和抽屉**共用同一个状态**，设置里改完抽屉立刻同步 - **分类可自动也可手动**：「智能分组」按名字关键词一键归类（不写死任何插件包名，认不出就留在未分组）；也能手动新建空分组、重命名、排序、删组，或**把条目直接拖到分组标题上** - **宽度可拖**：抽屉左缘拖拽调宽（260–560px），配置落 localStorage，刷新保留 - **首启引导**：第一次打开给「全部收纳 / 逐个挑」，不会静默把你的按钮变没；未整理时输入栏的 🧺 上会有一个小圆点，不拉开抽屉也知道有东西可整理 - **悬停即来、离开即走**：把手悬停 0.2 秒或点一下就滑出；**光标移开抽屉、或点击抽屉以外任何地方都会自动收起**（收起带与展开对称的滑出动画，不是一下消失）。只有在宽度拖拽中、或在搜索框里打字时才不收 - **自带诊断**：抽屉底部「诊断」会列出每个席位的「锚点在不在 / 注册项几个 / DOM 子节点几个 / 映射成不成立」，以及每个条目的真实 `registrant`，一键复制 ## 📦 安装 ```bash # 从 GitHub 安装（推荐） dsh plugin --profile web add github:wqy-cell/dsh-plugin-basket # 本地开发安装 dsh plugin --profile web add link:<本目录绝对路径> ``` 装完重启 Web 载体（`dsh web`）并刷新页面即可。 ### 本地开发 本仓库是唯一源码，DSH 实际从 profile 的两处副本加载，所以改完要同步： ```powershell pwsh -File sync-plugin.ps1 # 同步到 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/{plugins,node_modules} pwsh -File sync-plugin.ps1 -Check # 只比对不写入 ``` ## 🧭 使用 | 动作 | 怎么做 | |---|---| | 打开抽屉 | 点输入栏最左的 🧺，或点屏幕最右的**细长把手**（9 × 420 的极窄竖条，中间一个向左的折线；悬停 0.2 秒也会自动滑出） | | 打开某个插件 | 点抽屉里的图标 —— 等同于点它原来的按钮，插件的浮窗照常弹出 | | 收纳 / 贴回 | 鼠标移到条目上，点右侧的 📥 图标；底部「全部收纳 / 全部贴回」是全局开关 | | 标为常用 | 条目右侧的 📌，常用项会置顶到「常用」分区 | | 分类 | ① 底部「**智能分组**」按名字关键词一键归类；② 条目右侧的 📁 菜单里选「移动到分组」；③ **直接把条目拖到分组标题上**（拖到「未分组」即移出） | | 只看某一类 | 顶部三档筛选：**全部 / 你添加的 / 系统自带**（带实时计数）；选「系统自带」会自动展开那块，不用点两下 | | 管理分组 | 新建空分组用「你添加的插件」标题右侧的「＋ 分组」；在分组标题上悬停会露出 ▴ ▾ ✎ ✕（上移 / 下移 / 改名 / 删除，删除后条目回到未分组） | | 排序 | 把条目拖到另一个条目的**上半 / 下半**即插到它前面 / 后面；不想拖就用 📁 菜单里的「移到最前 / 移到最后」。没手动排过的分组保持原始顺序，不会被擅自重排 | | 搜索 | 抽屉顶部搜索框，匹配名字 / entry id / 来源 | | 调宽 / 收起 | 拖抽屉左缘调宽；**光标移开抽屉就自动收起**（0.24 秒余量，擦边不会误收），**点击抽屉以外的任何地方也会收起**；也可以点标题栏的 › 或按 Esc | | 看系统按钮 | 抽屉里「系统自带的按钮」分区点开（用来源筛选选「系统自带」会自动展开） | | 出问题时 | 抽屉底部「诊断」→「复制诊断信息」，把每个席位的锚点/注册项/DOM/映射与每个插件的 registrant 一起贴出来 | | 备份 / 搬家 | 底部「**配置**」先给一行摘要（几条设置 / 几个分组 / 宽度），需要时才点「**导出 JSON**」展开文本框「复制这段」；到新环境点「**导入…**」粘贴后「应用」。**导入是整体替换、不是合并**；同一处还有「恢复默认」（保留你调过的宽度） | | 批量管理 | `设置 → 插件收纳篮`：一张宽松的表格视图（每条一行，直接下拉选分组、标常用、收纳/贴回），系统项折叠在下方 | > 首次打开会看到「待整理 N 个插件按钮」。选**全部收纳**＝全部收进抽屉，输入栏立刻清爽； > 选**逐个挑**＝什么都不动，你自己一个个决定。 ## 🔧 它是怎么做到"不改一个插件"的 DSH 的界面由**插槽（slot）**组成，每个席位下挂着一串注册项。本插件用四层机制接管这些按钮： | 层 | 做什么 | 靠什么 | |---|---|---| | ① 发现 | 读出每个席位当前的注册项 | `ctx.slots.entriesOfSlot(slot)`（官方公开的检查面） | | ② 映射 | 把注册项对应到真实 DOM 节点 | `[data-slot="…"]` 锚点的第 i 个子节点 ↔ 排序后第 i 个注册项 | | ③ 隐藏 | 让原按钮从原位消失，但仍然活着 | 给节点打 `data-pb-hidden` 属性 + 一条 `display:none !important` 样式 | | ④ 镜像 | 抽屉里画自己的条目，点击时转发 | `node.querySelector("button").click()` | **为什么隐藏用 DOM 标记，而不是官方支持的「同 id + 更低优先级 shadow 注册」？** 因为 shadow 会让原按钮**根本不渲染**。那样一来既读不到它的 `aria-label` 与 SVG 图标， 也无法用"点原按钮"来打开插件的浮窗——原按钮必须一直活着，这也是本插件能零改造的前提。 ### 怎么判断"这是 DSH 自带的，还是你装的" **不看 `registrant`。** DSH 源码注释里明确说它是自报的、不能用来做归属判定： > `entry.registrant` is `options.registrant ?? fiber.name` … so a package could name itself something else — attributing by it would let a package impersonate another 而且实测在真实环境里它是 **空的**（第一版做完后看到"全部未识别"就是这么来的）。 改用「**席位 → 官方 entry id 名册**」：从已安装 DSH 版本的插槽目录里提取每个被监视席位上官方按钮的 id 清单，名单里没有的就不是这一版自带的东西。其中 `conversation.input.left` / `conversation.input.right` 的官方名册是**空**的 —— 这是最强的一条信息：**那两个席位上出现的每一个注册项都必然是你装的插件。** 判定顺序： 1. **手工标记**（条目菜单里标的，优先于一切自动判定） 2. `registrant` 前缀（有值就用，比名册更直接；实测常常为空） 3. **该席位的官方 entry id 名册**（主要依据） 4. 官方组件名（补住 `TerminalRecovery` 这类拿不到字面 id 的官方占用者） 5. 都认不出 → 「未识别」，**保守不参与自动收纳**，等你手工标一次 任何一条判错都能一键改回：条目菜单里有「标记为我添加的插件 / 标记为 DSH 自带 / 恢复自动判定」。诊断里也会写明每一条的**判定依据**。 ### 监视的席位 输入栏左右两席、输入框下方、会话标题栏左右两席、左侧栏底部。 `conversation.session.header.corner` **永不接管**：那是单席位，被系统右侧栏的展开按钮占着，收了会直接干掉系统入口。 ### 层级取值是量出来的，不是猜的 抽屉用 `z-index: 400`。实测这套界面的层级分布是： | 层 | 实测值 | |---|---| | 框架在流 UI | ≤ 101（layout 20 / 系统右侧栏 60 / 会话区 100） | | **本抽屉** | **400** | | 弹窗层 | 1000 – 1100 | | 插件自己的浮窗 | 9997 – 10001 | 所以抽屉盖得住系统右侧栏与所有在流 UI，又被设置弹窗和插件浮窗正确压住 —— 从抽屉里点开插件后，插件面板是压在抽屉上面的。这条已固化为回归测试（`mock-boot.cjs` 场景 8），避免以后被误改。 ## ⚠️ 已知限制与降级行为 本插件建立在「插槽锚点的 DOM 顺序与注册项顺序一致」这一约定上。它做了防御，但你应该知道边界： - **任何一层失败都不白屏**：锚点找不到、DOM 与注册项数量不一致时，该席位自动降级为「只读」（只列出条目，不隐藏、不代理），并在抽屉顶部显示告警。 - **单个插件按钮崩了不会连累别人**：若某个插件按钮在渲染时抛错，框架会在原位放一个错误占位。本插件保留该位置并把这一条标成「渲染失败」（不可点、不可收纳），**同一排的其它按钮照常收纳与点击**，不会因为一个坏按钮让整排失效。 - **不打扰流式输出**：DOM 监听只认「被监视席位内部的变动」与「席位挂载/卸载」两类信号，聊天区正文的持续改写会被忽略——模型输出时不会反复重扫。 - **抽屉位置会自检**：`position: fixed` 在带 `transform` 的祖先里会被捕获成相对定位，这是一种控制台不报错的静默失败。插件会量自己的右缘是否贴住视口右边，不对就在抽屉顶部给出告警并写进诊断。 - **官方名册跟着 DSH 版本走**：名册取自 `0.1.6-alpha.1`。升级 DSH 之后若官方在监视席位里新增了按钮，它可能被误判成"你添加的"——在条目菜单里「标记为 DSH 自带」一次即可（手工标记优先于一切自动判定，且记在配置里）。 - **完全没有会话时没有输入栏按钮**：`conversation.input.left` 由会话输入栏声明，Hero 新会话页上不存在，此时抽屉会显示空态。 - **改名 / 自定义分类 / 拖拽排序**中，改名与分类已支持；**拖拽排序**尚未实现（计划中）。 ## 🧪 开发与测试 ```powershell node test/mock-boot.cjs # 行为测试（模拟 DSH 客户端环境 + 假 DOM） node test/check-install.cjs # 装机自检（重启前跑，确认装对了） ``` `mock-boot.cjs` 覆盖：四层机制全链路、系统项判定、映射错位降级、单按钮崩溃隔离、 观测器过滤、通用角标探测、抽屉定位自检、slots 服务不可用降级、NEVER 席位保护、 UI SSR 渲染、配置持久化与边界夹紧。 `check-install.cjs` 只验证装机事实（不碰运行中的服务器）：源包完整性、两处装载目录 与源是否逐字节一致、副本身份、**bundle 注册 id 是否等于包名**（`dsh-client-modules` 的硬闸门，不等就整包静默不激活）、profile 的依赖与挂载声明、以及备份是否还在。 ## 📄 许可 MIT --- ## English **dsh-plugin-basket** — a collapsible drawer on the far right of the DSH Web client that gathers every third-party plugin button scattered across the composer row, the session header, and the sidebar footer. Categorize, search, pin, and pop the ones you use most back into place. Same composer row, before / after — the plugins keep running, their entries just stop crowding the tool row: ![before / after](assets/02-composer.png) **Zero plugin modifications required.** It discovers slot registrations through the public `ctx.slots.entriesOfSlot()` inspection surface, maps them onto the `[data-slot]` anchor's children, hides the originals with a `data-pb-hidden` attribute, and mirrors them as its own tiles — clicking a tile forwards a real click to the original button, so each plugin's own panel opens exactly as before. Built-in DSH buttons are never touched (with a manual override), the single-seat `conversation.session.header.corner` is never adopted, and every failure path degrades to a read-only listing instead of a blank screen.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 编辑器插件：在「+」按钮右侧新增 Skill 选择按钮，为下一条消息选择 Skill（不选/单选/多选），并支持把本地 md/txt 文件注册为仅当前会话可用的临时 Skill
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Skill Picker Plugin

为 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** Web 客户端新增的「Skill 选择按钮」：在输入框「+」按钮右侧，让用户为**下一条消息**选择要调用的 Skill（不选 / 单选 / 多选），并支持把一个本地 `.md` / `.txt` 文件临时注册成本会话可用的 Skill。

- 目标仓库：`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`（DSH 是 DeepSeek 官方项目，本仓库只承载这个插件作为**补丁提交**）
- 插件包名：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skill-picker`

---

## 仓库结构

```
dsh/
  packages/client/ui-skill-picker/          ← 新增插件包（node 半边 + 浏览器半边 + Remote）
  .agents/notes/implemented/feature/         ← 本功能的 Agent Note（中英）
dsh-patch/after/                            ← 需要在 DSH 中修改的 8 个文件（改后内容）
dsh-patch/CHANGES.patch                     ← 上述文件的统一 diff（生成后写入）
MANIFEST.sha256                             ← 所有文件的校验清单
```

`dsh-patch/after/` 里的文件是**改后全文**，对应的仓库相对路径就是它在 `after/` 下的路径。
应用方式：把 `after/` 下的文件覆盖到你的 DSH 检出对应路径；或直接应用 `CHANGES.patch`。

---

## 它做了什么

| 需求 | 实现 |
|---|---|
| 「+」右侧新增按钮 | 注册一个 `conversation.input.left` list cell —— 该 slot **本来就渲染在「+」紧右侧**，因此**没有改动 `ui-conversation` 一行代码** |
| 折叠栏（展开/关闭/点外/Esc） | 面板锚定在 composer 卡片上沿（与 `/` 菜单、popupSelect 同一套 `bottom: calc(100% + 4px)` 规则），外卖点击落在卡片内则不关闭 |
| 列表 + 搜索 | 数据来自现有 `skills/list` Remote（按会话 single-flight 缓存），搜索按名称/描述做有序子序列匹配 |
| 0/1/多选 | 状态是 `selected: string[]`，点整行切换 |
| chips | 已选项显示为 chips，可单独移除、可一键清空 |
| 按钮高亮 + 数量 | `data-active` 属性选择器 + 数量角标 |
| 添加本地 Skill 文件 | 折叠栏底部入口 → 解析 front matter → 经本包自有 Remote 注册为**该会话作用域**的运行时 Skill 并自动选中 |
| 临时 Skill 仅本会话、发送后取消选中但保留在列表 | 注册落在 Agent scope layer；发送成功后清空选择，行仍留在列表 |
| 请求携带已选 Skill | 选择被写成正文里的 `/name` 手势（`dsh-tool-skill` 的 `agent/pre-step` 已解析并注入正文），**不新增第二条注入通道** |

### 为什么用 `/name` 手势而不是新增字段

Host 的 `dsh-tool-skill` 的 `agent/pre-step` 会扫描已认领用户消息里所有 `/<name>` token，逐个解析并把 `renderSkillContent` 结果作为 instructions 注入。这条既有边界天然满足：多个 Skill 随一条消息发出、`disable-model-invocation` Skill 可达、"只影响下一条"（发送即清空草稿）。所以本插件只做 UI + 把选择变成手势。

---

## 安装到 DSH

前置：DSH 源码检出、Node `^22.19 || >=24`、pnpm。

```bash
# 1. 复制插件包
cp -r dsh/packages/client/ui-skill-picker  <DSH>/packages/client/ui-skill-picker
cp -r dsh/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-19-composer-skill-picker*.md \
      <DSH>/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/

# 2. 应用对既有文件的修改（8 个文件）
cd <DSH> && git apply /path/to/CHANGES.patch

# 3. 安装依赖（新增了 zod 与两个 peer，必须装）
pnpm install

# 4. 构建 + 启动
pnpm run build:lib     # host + client 两个构建面（生成 typert 产物）
pnpm run build:web     # 刷新前端 dist
pnpm run start:desktop
```

开发期热更：`pnpm run dev:web` 配合 `pnpm dsh web`。

### 8 个需要修改的文件及其原因

| 文件 | 改了什么 / 为什么 |
|---|---|
| `packages/api/remotes/src/client/index.ts` | 把本包的 Remote contribution 加进 Client 装配列表（仓库里所有 namespace 的统一挂载点） |
| `packages/api/remotes/package.json` | 声明对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skill-picker` 的依赖 |
| `packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` | 新增 `ui-skill-picker` 浏览器插件行 |
| `packages/bundle/web-app/package.json` | 声明该 bundle 对插件包的依赖（`verify-cordis-config` 要求） |
| `scripts/package-dependency-policy.ts` | `PEER_REQUIRED_HOST_EXPORTS` 增加 `dsh-scope: createScope` 与 `dsh-skill: isSkillName`（**仓库规定此类新增须人工评审，PR 里需单列标题**） |
| `scripts/verify-package-readme-model-experience.ts` | README 门禁的 allowlist 增加本包（`kind: indirect`） |
| `tsconfig.base.json` | 手写路径别名（包名与目录名不同，生成器不覆盖） |
| `tsconfig.client.json` | Client 聚合 references 增加本包 |

---

## 已知限制

- **发送成功即清空草稿**，因此"发送失败后手势丢失"由 chips 旁的「重新附加」按钮处理；发送失败时选择本身会保留。
- **临时 Skill 需要活跃 Agent**：冷会话会被拒绝，而不是把注册放宽到全局层。
- **临时 Skill 不落盘**，随进程结束消失；永久安装仍是 skill 文件系统的职责。
- **文本即载荷**：手工键入的 `/name` 与选择器选中的在协议上不可区分。

### 已修复的一个真实 bug（编码）

最初的实现用 `file.text()` 读取本地文件，**一律按 UTF-8 解码**。中文 Windows 编辑器默认写 **GBK**，于是 GBK 字节被解成 `U+FFFD` 替换字符并被当成 Skill 正文注册（表现为乱码）。

现在 `src/client/domain.ts` 的 `decodeSkillText` 以**严格 UTF-8 解码器做判别器**，失败则回退 **GB18030**，并剥离 BOM；`tests/browser-plugin.client.spec.ts` 里有对应的回归用例（UTF-8 不被改动 / 真实 GBK 字节正确解出中文 / 带 BOM 仍能解析 front matter）。

---

## 验证状态

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `tsc -b` 两个 face | 通过 |
| `tsdown` host / client 两面 | 通过，产出 `typert.host.js` / `typert.remote-client.js` / `client.js` |
| 真实浏览器（Edge + Playwright） | 按钮存在、折叠栏可展开、搜索框与底部入口就位、列表渲染真实 Skill、**Console 零报错** |
| 纯函数与编码回归用例 | 通过（16 个用例中 11 个） |
| 插件注册类用例 | **未通过** —— 原因见下 |

### 未通过项说明（仓库既有缺陷，非本插件引入）

`sections/scripts/test-invariants.ts`（Vitest 全局 setup）在 `fiber.ctx.fiber.state` 处抛
`TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'PENDING')`，使**任何在 spec 中直接调用 `ctx.plugin()`** 的用例失败。

对照证据：**未修改的** `packages/client/ui-plan/tests/browser-plugin.client.spec.ts` 报完全相同的错误（4 个用例挂 2 个）。因此插件注册类用例的失败属于该全局 setup 与 `ctx.plugin()` 的兼容问题。

---

## License

与 DSH 上游一致（MIT）。本仓库内容为对 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` 的补丁贡献。

plugins.description: Deployment-level deadlines for dsh tool calls that declare none: mounted on the tools/execute waterfall, it turns a silently wedged tool call into a model-visible TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.
plugins.readme_text:
# @argszero/cordis-plugin-tool-deadline-guard

A cordis plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`)
that puts a deadline on tool calls that declare none — the calls for which
nothing in the harness arms anything today.

```
input:  user        "keep working on the migration until it is done"
        assistant   tool_calls: [subagent(prompt="...") id=call-1]
        ⋯           nothing in the log, nothing on screen, turn still "running"
```

A tool call is bounded exactly when its own definition says so.
`ToolDefinition.timeoutMs` is optional ("Cooperative tool-call timeout budget in
milliseconds. Omit for no deadline"), and the core enforcer
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy`, mounted by the base bundle) opens
with `if (timeoutMs === undefined) return next()`. Omit the field and *nothing
arms anything* — not a timer, not a signal, not a diagnostic.

That omission is the norm rather than the exception. Of the 40 non-test source
files calling `defineTool(` at `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2`, **26 contain no `timeoutMs`
at all** — 25 shipped tool modules plus the test fixture helper — among them
`tool-subagent` (delegation), `mcp-resources` (tools owned by someone else's
server), `tool-terminal`, `tool-ask-user`, the fs read/write/edit tools, and
`tool-workflow` / `tool-ralph` / `tool-todo` / `plan-mode`. Two of those are
exactly where a long-horizon run spends its time: a delegation whose child never
settles, and a tool on the far side of a network boundary.

The symptom is not an error. It is a turn that keeps rendering as running with
nothing anywhere to explain it. Compare the model call: the provider adapters
announce a stall (`DEFAULT_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` = 300_000, re-armed per chunk
by `idleWatchdog`), so **silence is the signature of a wedged tool call, not a
wedged model call**. Reported as discussion
[#7339](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/7339)
("long-horizon tasks stall with nothing in the output"), and adjacent to
[#6226](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6226) (a
foreground `subagent` call whose child process had already exited).

Mounted, the same call ends with something the model can act on:

```
        tool_result [error] "tool call to "subagent" timed out: it exceeded the
                    600000ms deadline supplied by the tool-deadline-guard mount,
                    and the tool declares no timeoutMs of its own"
```

**0.2.0 adds the other half.** A call can also hang *before* it is dispatched,
where no declared budget and no `tools/execute` wrapper can reach it — see
[The other half](#the-other-half-a-call-that-hangs-before-it-is-dispatched). The
same mount now covers that phase too, under its own code
(`TOOL_PRE_EXECUTE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`), so a deployment can tell a body that ran
too long from a body that never ran at all.

## Install

```sh
npm install @argszero/cordis-plugin-tool-deadline-guard
```

In a `cordis.yml` / profile bundle, add the row (or merge this package's
`cordis.patch.yml`, which contains the same one):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: tool-deadline-guard
      name: '@argszero/cordis-plugin-tool-deadline-guard'
```

With no configuration it bounds every tool that declares no `timeoutMs` at ten
minutes and dispatches every other call untouched.

| field | default | meaning |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `mode` | `auto` | `auto` arms deadlines; `observe` reports what it *would* bound and dispatches unchanged; `off` registers nothing |
| `defaultTimeoutMs` | `600000` | budget for a tool that declares none (10 minutes) |
| `perTool` | `{}` | per-tool budgets by resolved tool name; wins over `defaultTimeoutMs` |
| `exempt` | `[]` | tool names this mount never bounds, whatever else is configured |
| `applyTo` | `undeclared` | `undeclared` leaves a tool that declares `timeoutMs` to the core policy; `all` bounds every known tool |
| `onExpiry` | `cooperative` | what an expiry does; see [Honest limits](#honest-limits) |
| `preExecute` | `true` | bound the phase *before* dispatch too; see [The other half](#the-other-half-a-call-that-hangs-before-it-is-dispatched) |
| `preExecuteTimeoutMs` | `defaultTimeoutMs` | budget for that phase |
| `warnLimit` | `5` | diagnostics emitted per mount; `0` silences them |

A budget must be a positive finite number ≤ 2147483647 (`setTimeout`'s
saturation point): a larger value would fire immediately, so "no deadline" is
expressed by leaving a tool out of scope — `exempt`, or `mode: off` — rather than
by asking for infinity.

## What it does, precisely

The plugin mounts on two documented public seams — `tools/execute` (the same one
the core policy uses) and `tools/pre-execute` (the phase in front of it) — and
for each dispatch:

1. **Resolves the tool's own definition** (`ctx.tools.get(exec.name, exec.agent)`)
   and decides whether to arm at all. An unknown tool is the registry's business
   (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`), and there is no definition to weigh a budget against.
2. **Arms one timer and one controller**, and hands the tool a fused signal
   (`AbortSignal.any([caller, own])`) through `exec.signal`, exactly as the core
   policy hands it its derived deadline.
3. **Restores the caller's signal in a `finally`**, so post-execute listeners and
   every later wrapper never see this mount's (possibly already-aborted) signal —
   the rule the core policy documents for the same reason.
4. **Substitutes a result only when its own timer fired.** A call that settles
   inside its budget returns the tool's own result object, unchanged: no
   re-dispatch, no wrapper, no diagnostic.
5. **Races the pre-dispatch phase on the same kind of timer** and denies the call
   if that phase is the thing that hung; a phase that settles inside its budget
   dispatches the call untouched, and a phase that fails on its own keeps the
   registry's own error path.

An expired body budget produces the shape the loop already understands —
`isError: true` with `error.info.code === 'TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED'` — under a
code **this plugin owns**, deliberately not the core policy's `TOOL_TIMEOUT`: a
deployment can then tell "the tool declared a budget and blew it" from "this
mount supplied a budget the tool never declared", which is the difference
between a tool bug and a deployment policy. `ToolTimeoutError`-style routing on
`TOOL_TIMEOUT` keeps working for declared tools and does not silently capture
these.

An expired **pre-dispatch** phase is a different fact, so it gets a different
code (`TOOL_PRE_EXECUTE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`) and a different shape (`deny`, not a
replaced result). See the next section.

## The other half: a call that hangs before it is dispatched

`timeoutMs` bounds the *body*. It cannot bound the phase that runs in front of
the body, and nothing else does either: the core policy is a `tools/execute`
wrapper, so the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall completes before the policy is ever
reached. A listener there that awaits unbounded work therefore stalls **every**
call in the session with no timer anywhere in the tree — and a deadline mounted
on `tools/execute` is structurally unable to see it, because that waterfall is
never entered.

That is not hypothetical. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes` awaits the turn
recorder's snapshot queue inside `tools/pre-execute` before calling `next()`
(`packages/deliverables/workspace-changes/src/index.ts:174-182`), so every tool
call in the session waits behind it — and when the recorder's git subprocess is
the thing that wedged, the pending call names the *tool* while the wedge is
somewhere else entirely. Reported that way in
[#9515](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9515) (git
checkpoints among the wedging channels).

Mounted, the same call is denied rather than left pending:

```
        tool_result [error] tool call to "subagent" was not dispatched: the
                    pre-execute phase exceeded the 600000ms deadline supplied
                    by the tool-deadline-guard mount
```

with `error.info.code === 'TOOL_PRE_EXECUTE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED'`. The second code
is not decoration: it says the body **never ran**, so nothin

# DSH Notify

Browser and Slack notifications for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Get notified when a task finishes, fails, or needs attention.

Browser notifications appear on the computer viewing DSH, even when DSH runs on a remote server. Slack notifications continue when no browser is connected.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the **0.2.0-rc.2 API**.
- Node.js **22.19+ or 24+**.
- For browser notifications: a desktop browser supporting Notifications, Web Locks, and EventSource, using HTTPS or HTTP on localhost.
- For Slack notifications: a Slack incoming webhook URL.

## Installation

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:iruoy/dsh-notify
dsh web
```

The repository includes compiled files, so installation requires no build step.

## Setup

Open **Settings → Notify**.

### Browser notifications

1. Click **Enable notifications** and allow the browser permission prompt.
2. Choose which events should produce browser notifications.
3. Click **Save settings**.
4. Click **Send test notification** to check delivery.

Keep at least one DSH tab open to receive notifications. Multiple tabs in the same browser profile produce one notification per event. Clicking a notification focuses DSH and opens the session.

If permission is blocked, allow notifications in the browser's site settings. Operating-system notification settings may also silence notifications.

### Slack notifications

1. Paste an incoming webhook URL into the webhook field.
2. Set **DSH base URL** to the address used to access DSH, such as `https://dsh.example.com`.
3. Choose which events should be sent to Slack.
4. Click **Save settings**, then **Send Slack test**.

Messages include the event, session title, workspace path, human input (up to 1,500 characters), duration, model/provider, reasoning effort, and per-turn token usage when available, plus an **Open in DSH** link when a base URL is configured. Human input is included independently of the optional response summary; injected instructions and tool results are excluded. The base URL defaults to the current browser origin when settings are saved.

Token usage is grouped by model and effort, including reported usage from failed attempts. Input, output, and cache counters are shown separately; a total is shown only when DSH supplies it for every reported call. Missing usage is marked as partial, and missing effort is shown as “Not reported”. Counts cover the observed turn, not the whole session or its subagents.

To replace a webhook, enter the new URL and save. Leaving the field blank keeps the existing webhook. To remove it, click **Remove webhook**, then save.

### Estimated API cost

Slack notifications also show an **estimated API cost in USD** for exact `openai` and `anthropic` provider/model matches in the [Models.dev public catalog](https://models.dev). DSH’s `codex` provider is mapped to `openai`; `claude` and `claude-code` are mapped to `anthropic`. These routes use exact model IDs and are labeled **Estimated API-equivalent cost**, since public API rates do not represent subscription billing. No API key is required. Prices are community-maintained public list rates, not your billed amount or subscription cost; custom routes, discounts, service tiers, and separately billed tools are not accounted for.

The plugin downloads `https://models.dev/api.json` in the background on startup when its cache is missing or more than 24 hours old, then checks hourly for a refresh. Validated prices are saved in `pricing.json` beside `state.json`, so they survive restarts. Catalogs larger than 10 MiB are rejected to bound memory and parsing pauses. Failed refreshes keep the last successful cache and retry after an hour. Notifications never wait for pricing downloads: unavailable prices are marked **Unavailable**, and prices more than 24 hours old are marked **stale cache**.

Each reported call is priced separately using uncached input, output, cache-read, and cache-write counts and applicable catalog context-size tiers. Reasoning tokens are not added again to output tokens. Missing models, rates, or usage, and usage counters that are not safe nonnegative integers, are never treated as free: partial estimates show how many calls could be priced. The per-turn estimate is saved with the notification so retries and restarts preserve the original amount. Prices are downloaded without sending prompts, session information, or token usage to Models.dev.

## Events

All eight events are enabled by default for both destinations. Browser and Slack event selections are independent.

| Event | Notification |
| --- | --- |
| `completed` | Task completed |
| `error` | Task failed |
| `aborted` | Task aborted |
| `blocked` | Task blocked |
| `max-tokens` | Token limit reached |
| `interrupted` | DSH reports an interrupted turn during recovery |
| `approval` | Approval requested |
| `question` | Question asked |

**Browser notifications for subagents** and **Slack notifications for subagents** are separate opt-ins, both off by default. Slack never sends child completions, even after opt-in; other selected child events can be sent. Child terminal and approval notices can include human input, independently of the summary setting. Question notices include only a session identifier, not the question text.

**Include response summaries in Slack** is also off by default. Enabling it adds up to 1,500 characters of assistant response text. Summaries may contain code or sensitive task details. Session titles are included regardless of this setting.

Test buttons work independently of event selections.

## Delivery history and retries

**Recent deliveries** shows the last 20 events, browser and Slack delivery status, and retry or error details.

- Browser connections can replay missed notifications from the last 200 stored events after reconnecting. A first-time browser starts with new events. If display fails, delivery pauses without advancing the cursor; check permissions and focus the receiving tab to retry. The tab retains leadership while paused so later events cannot skip the failed notice. Successful receipts are retried while the tab remains open, independently of display.
- Slack keeps a persistent queue of up to 100 pending notifications, which survives DSH restarts.
- On upgrade, queued task completions without an agent classification are cancelled, including main-task completions: older records cannot distinguish them from subagents. Identified main-task completions remain queued; subagent completions are cancelled. Queued child events from older releases are also cancelled unless Slack subagent delivery is explicitly enabled.
- Network failures, rate limits, and Slack server errors retry up to six total attempts. Rate-limit responses respect Slack's requested retry delay.
- Removing or replacing a webhook, disabling Slack or its subagent opt-in, or deselecting an event cancels affected pending deliveries. Requests already in flight may still arrive.

Browser delivery status indicates that a browser accepted the notification; the operating system may still suppress it. Sleeping computers and suspended tabs can delay delivery. Separate devices or browser profiles can each receive a copy.

A crash immediately after Slack accepts a message can cause that message to be sent again after restart.

## Storage and remote access

Settings, the webhook, pending deliveries, and history are stored in:

```text
$DSH_HOME/dsh-notify/state.json
```

Without `DSH_HOME`, the default is `~/.dsh/dsh-notify/state.json`. State files have owner-only read/write permissions. The saved webhook is never returned to the browser; settings show only whether one is configured.

State and pricing snapshots use asynchronous filesystem operations. State mutations are serialized; browser publication and successful settings/receipt responses wait for the snapshot to be written, synced, atomically renamed, and its directory synced. Terminal notices held until a session goes idle drain in ordered batches of at most 100, with publication only after each batch is durable. Every notice is validated against the persisted-state rules be

plugins.description: 核动力草泥马 - DSH Web GUI desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# 核动力草泥马 (dsh-caonima) 🦙⚛️

> DSH Web GUI 桌宠插件:屏幕右下角住着一只**网红草泥马**,它会随着当前 Agent 的工作状态改变行为。npm 包名即 `dsh-caonima`。

![views](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hzhgino/dsh-caonima/traffic/traffic/badge.json)

![preview](./preview.jpg)

## Quick Start

```bash
# 安装（二选一，当前推荐 GitHub 源，npm 发布后即可用包名）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hzhgino/dsh-caonima
# 或（npm 发布后）            dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-caonima

# 重启 web host 并刷新浏览器页面，草泥马出现在右下角
dsh web
```

> 需要 `dsh` v0.1.5+。卸载:`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-caonima`,重启后桌宠消失。

## 行为一览

| Agent / 会话状态 | 草泥马的表现 |
|---|---|
| 空闲(idle) | 沿屏幕底部**慢速散步**,时不时停下喘气、眨眼、耳朵抖动;闲置 50 秒后**打盹**(闭眼冒 zZz) |
| 正在工作(running) | **快步巡逻**,四肢走马灯,气泡实时播报正在执行的工具(`🖥️ bash…`、`🔍 grep…`),偶尔蹲下吃两口草 🌿 |
| 等待审批(approval/asked) | 原地**急跳** + 橙色警报气泡「⚠️ 需要批准」,批复后恢复工作 |
| 回合结束(turn/end) | **三连跳庆祝** 「🎉 搞定啦~ 咴儿咴儿!」(翻车时改成 😵) |
| 新消息到达 | 「📥 收到!出发~」 |

互动彩蛋:

- **戳一戳**:摇头晃脑 + 爱心/草叶粒子 + 随机「泥马语录」;打盹时被戳会惊醒 😳
- **拎起来**:可以按住拖动到任意高度松手,四肢下垂摇摆,落地带重力回弹
- 嘴上的草一直在随风摆动(致敬经典表情包)

## 工作原理

这是一个标准的 DSH 双面包(dual-face)插件:

- `lib/index.js` — 宿主(node)半:空的 `apply()`,只为让 Loader 存在一行,使 `dsh-client-modules` 扫描到本包的 `dsh.client` 声明;
- `lib/client.js` — 浏览器半:`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册的可懒加载 bundle,不依赖 React(零 `require`),声明 `dsh.client.immediately: true` 使其在启动时即被物化;
- 状态来源:`ctx.sessions`(`dsh-api-session-controller` 浏览器半)
  - `sessions.list` → 当前选中会话
  - `binding.session`(ObservableSnapshot)→ `snapshot.running` → 散步/工作切换
  - `binding.eventSource`(会话事件窗口)→ 增量扫描 `tool/call`、`approval/*`、`turn/end` 等事件驱动表情与气泡(首载/重连只快进,不回放历史)

动画全部为 CSS keyframes + `requestAnimationFrame` 定位;卸载(dispose / HMR 换血)时移除节点与 `<style data-plugin>`,不留残留。

## 安装

### 推荐方式：profile bundle 正式安装

本包声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`（`cordis.patch.yml` 按包名插入 `caonima` 行），克隆后直接：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hzhgino/dsh-caonima.git
cd dsh-caonima
dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)"     # 发布到 npm 后也可按包名 add
```

然后**重启一次 web host**（bundle 层栈的变化在启动时组装），刷新浏览器页面即可。

> 卸载:`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-caonima`,重启后桌宠消失。

### 免打包方式：patch 直挂（开发尝鲜，免重启）

把插件按绝对路径插入 web profile 的 patch 层，`patchReload: live` 的 profile 会让运行中的 host 热重组（无需重启，刷新页面即见）：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: caonima
      name: /绝对路径/dsh-caonima/lib/index.js
```

> ⚠️ 二选一：两种方式同时生效时，同一 client 包会被两个 Loader 来源解析，composition 会显式拒绝——正式安装前先删掉 patch 里的路径 insert 行。

## 开发迭代(热更新)

`client-hmr` 的 node 半会轮询每个 in-graph bundle 的文件状态:
直接编辑 `lib/client.js` 并保存 → 正在打开的页面**无需刷新**即被原地换血(插件内部状态重置,连接与会话不受影响)。

## 发布到 npm（可选）

`package.json` 已设 `publishConfig` 并移除 `"private": true`，登录后即可：

```bash
npm login
npm publish
```

发布后安装就是一条命令，且支持 `update`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-caonima
```

## 访问量

![views](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hzhgino/dsh-caonima/traffic/traffic/views.svg)

> 数据来自 GitHub Traffic API，由 `.github/workflows/traffic.yml` 每天自动采集；因官方只保留 14 天，脚本会把每日数据累积到 `traffic` 分支的 `history.json`，从而形成长期趋势。图例：`views` 为总浏览量，`unique visitors` 为独立访客。
